title: Chicago blues
style: English, male vocal, Chicago blues, electric guitar, harmonica, shuffle, gritty, 84 bpm
lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse]
Woke up this morning, rain was on my door,
Woke up this morning, rain was on my door,
I got a heavy heart, can't take it anymore.

[Chorus]
Lord, I got the blues, the Windy City blues,
Lord, I got the blues, the Windy City blues,
Walking down State Street in my worn-out shoes.

[Verse]
My baby left me, took the last train out of town,
My baby left me, took the last train out of town,
But I'll keep on singing till the sun goes down.

[Chorus]
Lord, I got the blues, the Windy City blues,
Lord, I got the blues, the Windy City blues,
Walking down State Street in my worn-out shoes.

[Outro]
